recognize_zh: Diff-Quik 觸片中可見成團及散在的大型細胞，細胞質豐富淡藍、帶細小空泡，細胞核圓至腎形、部分可見核溝或摺痕，混有少數嗜酸性球（紅色顆粒）與紅血球；這些大型組織球樣細胞為淋巴結 LCH 的腫瘤性蘭格漢斯細胞。
features: Loose clusters and single large cells with abundant pale blue, finely vacuolated cytoplasm
Round, reniform or irregular nuclei, some folded or grooved, with fine chromatin and inconspicuous nucleoli
Few eosinophils with orange-red granules and smaller lymphocytes admixed
Background of red blood cells, small vacuoles and stripped/crushed nuclear strands
describe_en: Diff-Quik-stained touch imprint of the lymph node shows cellular clusters and dispersed large cells with abundant pale, finely vacuolated cytoplasm and round to reniform nuclei with occasional folds or grooves, fine chromatin and inconspicuous nucleoli. A few eosinophils and small lymphocytes are admixed in a background of red blood cells and crushed nuclear material. Air drying accentuates the size difference between the large neoplastic cells and the small lymphocytes. Findings are consistent with Langerhans cell histiocytosis in the appropriate histologic and immunophenotypic (CD1a/langerin positive) context.

ddx.vs: RDD histiocytes are larger with emperipolesis of intact lymphocytes and round nuclei with a nucleolus, lacking the grooved reniform nuclei.
Carcinoma cells form tight cohesive three-dimensional clusters with nuclear molding and prominent nucleoli, unlike these loosely aggregated grooved cells with eosinophils.
Sinus histiocytes have abundant foamy cytoplasm and bland oval nuclei without grooves and are CD1a negative.
ALCL cells are larger and more pleomorphic with horseshoe nuclei, basophilic cytoplasm and prominent nucleoli, and are CD30/ALK positive.
